title: Execution Trace
subtitle: Inspect durable records for one message, Agent, model, tool, and delivery workflow. Streaming stores final semantic state rather than every incremental packet.

list.title: Trace list
list.subtitle: Newest finished work first. Select a trace to inspect spans, events, artifacts, and links.

detail.title: Trace detail
detail.subtitle: Spans retain real parent-child relationships; causal work outside the tree is shown as a link.
detail.empty: Select a trace from the list.

artifact.title: Artifact content
artifact.empty: Content is unavailable or has been cleaned up.
artifact.truncated: This Artifact was truncated during capture.

confirm.clearText: This deletes every terminal trace and any Artifact no longer referenced by a trace. Running traces are preserved.
confirm.deleteText: This deletes the selected trace and any Artifact no longer referenced by a trace.
